from pathlib import Path
import base64, lzma, hashlib, json
live = json.loads(Path('COOPERATION.json').read_text())
peers = [peer for peer in live["peers"] if peer["id"] == "initial_goal_1"]
assert len(peers) == 1
peer = peers[0]
objective = peer["objective"]
assert hashlib.sha256(objective.encode()).hexdigest() == peer["objectiveDigest"]
begin, end = "\nCHARACTER_REFERENCE_PAYLOAD_BEGIN\n", "\nCHARACTER_REFERENCE_PAYLOAD_END"
assert objective.count(begin) == 1 and objective.count(end) == 1
encoded = objective.split(begin, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0]
compressed = base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
assert hashlib.sha256(compressed).hexdigest() == "b8770472bb249511979c460748c940883f51cfd57a5931d16cf1882ceb089ff5"
candidate = lzma.decompress(compressed)
assert len(candidate) == 796309
assert hashlib.sha256(candidate).hexdigest() == "0ec8e7e2fbe9ff7f2d4c849c7558c152e24d707d79943d6f7ac08d0b27fa98c9"
destination = Path("generated/problem/Submission.lean")
assert destination.is_file() and not destination.is_symlink()
destination.write_bytes(candidate)
print(hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), len(candidate))
